actions.name: which_key_end
actions.basis: A which-key overlay is a terminal keymap affordance: it exists to make an unbounded keymap discoverable in a keyboard-only surface. A desktop app with a visible sidebar, visible chrome controls and a help surface has no equivalent, and adding an overlay would duplicate those controls rather than add capability.
